sn46.53:1.1: atha kho sambahulā bhikkhū pubbaṇhasamayaṃ nivāsetvā pattacīvaramādāya sāvatthiṃ piṇḍāya pavisiṃsu
sn46.53:2.1: evaṃvādino bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā evamassu vacanīyā:
sn46.53:2.2: “yasmiṃ āvuso, samaye līnaṃ cittaṃ hoti, katamesaṃ tasmiṃ samaye bojjhaṅgānaṃ akālo bhāvanāya, katamesaṃ tasmiṃ samaye bojjhaṅgānaṃ kālo bhāvanāya:
sn46.53:2.3: yasmiṃ panāvuso samaye uddhataṃ cittaṃ hoti, katamesaṃ tasmiṃ samaye bojjhaṅgānaṃ akālo bhāvanāya, katamesaṃ tasmiṃ samaye bojjhaṅgānaṃ kālo bhāvanāyā”ti.
sn46.53:2.4: evaṃ puṭṭhā bhikkhave, aññatitthiyā paribbājakā na ceva sampāyissanti, uttariñca vighātaṃ āpajjissanti.
sn46.53:3.1: nāhaṃ taṃ bhikkhave, passāmi sadevake loke samārake sabrahmake sassamaṇabrāhmaṇiyā pajāya sadevamanussāya yo imesaṃ pañhānaṃ veyyākaraṇena cittaṃ ārādheyya aññatra tathāgatena vā tathāgatasāvakena vā ito vā pana sutvā.
sn46.53:4.1: yasmiṃ bhikkhave, samaye līnaṃ cittaṃ hoti, akālo tasmiṃ samaye passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya. akālo samādhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya. akālo upekhāsambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya.
sn46.53:4.3: līnaṃ bhikkhave cittaṃ. taṃ etehi dhammehi dussamuṭṭhāpayaṃ hoti.
sn46.53:5.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, puriso parittaṃ aggiṃ ujjāletukāmo assa.
sn46.53:5.2: so tattha allāni ceva tiṇāni pakkhipeyya, allāni ca gomayāni pakkhipeyya, allāni ca kaṭṭhāni pakkhipeyya, udakavātañca dadeyya, paṃsukena ca okireyya.
sn46.53:5.3: bhabbo nu kho so puriso parittaṃ aggiṃ ujjāletunti?
sn46.53:6.1: evameva kho bhikkhave, yasmiṃ samaye līnaṃ cittaṃ hoti, akālo tasmiṃ samaye passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya. akālo samādhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya. akālo upekhāsambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya.
sn46.53:6.3: līnaṃ bhikkhave, cittaṃ taṃ etehi dhammehi dussamuṭṭhāpayaṃ hoti.
sn46.53:7.1: yasmiṃ ca kho bhikkhave, samaye līnaṃ cittaṃ hoti. kālo tasmiṃ samaye dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya, kālo viriyasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya. kālo pītisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya.
sn46.53:7.3: līnaṃ bhikkhave cittaṃ. taṃ etehi dhammehi susamuṭṭhāpayaṃ hoti.
sn46.53:8.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, puriso parittaṃ aggiṃ ujjāletukāmo assa.
sn46.53:8.2: so tattha sukkhāni ceva tiṇāni pakkhipeyya. sukkhāni gomayāni pakkhipeyya. sukkhāni kaṭṭhāni pakkhipeyya, mukhavātaṃ ca dadeyya. na ca paṃsukena okireyya
sn46.53:8.3: bhabbo nu kho so puriso parittaṃ aggiṃ ujjāletunti.
sn46.53:9.1: evameva kho bhikkhave, yasmiṃ samaye līnaṃ cittaṃ hoti, kālo tasmiṃ samaye dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya. kālo viriyasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya. kālo pītisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya.
sn46.53:9.3: līnaṃ bhikkhave cittaṃ, taṃ etehi dhammehi susamuṭṭhāpayaṃ hoti.
sn46.53:10.1: yasmiṃ bhikkhave, samaye uddhataṃ cittaṃ hoti, akālo tasmiṃ samaye dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya. akālo viriyasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya. akālo pītisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya.
sn46.53:10.3: uddhataṃ bhikkhave cittaṃ, taṃ etehi dhammehi duvūpasamayaṃ hoti.
sn46.53:11.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, puriso mahantaṃ aggikkhandhaṃ nibbāpetukāmo assa.
sn46.53:11.2: so tattha sukkhāni ceva tiṇāni pakkhipeyya. sukkhāni ca gomayāni pakkhipeyya, sukkhāni ca kaṭṭhāni pakkhipeyya, mukhavātañca dadeyya, na ca paṃsukena okireyya.
sn46.53:11.3: bhabbo nu kho so puriso mahantaṃ aggikkhandhaṃ nibbāpetunti?
sn46.53:12.1: evameva kho bhikkhave, yasmiṃ samaye uddhataṃ cittaṃ hoti, akālo tasmiṃ samaye dhammavicayasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya. akālo viriyasambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya, akālo pītisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya.
sn46.53:12.3: uddhataṃ bhikkhave, cittaṃ taṃ etehi dhammehi duvūpasamaṃ hoti.
sn46.53:13.1: yasmiṃ bhikkhave, samaye uddhataṃ cittaṃ hoti, kālo tasmiṃ samaye passaddhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya, kālo samādhisambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya, kālo upekhāsambojjhaṅgassa bhāvanāya.
sn46.53:13.3: uddhataṃ bhikkhave cittaṃ. taṃ etehi dhammehi suvūpasamaṃ hoti.
sn46.53:14.1: seyyathāpi bhikkhave, puriso mahantaṃ aggikkhandhaṃ nibbāpetukāmo assa.

sn46.53:14.3: bhabbo nu kho so puriso mahantaṃ aggikkhandhaṃ nibbāpetunti?
